title: wooddeck .deck file — envelope v2
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for the wooddeck .deck v2 file format. v2 adds Epic 2's foundation model: the design payload REQUIRES `structure` (elevated | floating) and `foundation` (discriminated union on `type`). The pre-S17 top-level `post` field was REMOVED in this schema (review-gate FIX 2) — `foundation.post` (inside the posts-on-footings variant) is now the SINGLE source of truth for the post material. `additionalProperties:false` on `DeckDesign` rejects a leftover top-level `post`, so a v1 file must go through migrateV1ToV2 before v2 validation. The envelope stays lenient at the root (no additionalProperties:false) so a future v3 producer may append additive metadata; the design payload is strict (additionalProperties:false at every level) so unknown fields are rejected, never silently dropped. Loader logic MUST switch on `schema` and refuse any value other than 2 (with v1 migration handled by a separate loader path).

schema.description: Envelope version. Frozen at 2 for the Epic 2 release; a new major format is a new schema number.

generator.description: Producing application identifier — always the literal string 'wooddeck'.

generatorVersion.description: SemVer version of the producing wooddeck build (from package.json at build time). Pattern accepts MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -prerelease and/or +build suffix (both suffix segments are folded together in the pattern for simplicity).

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 date-time at which the file was produced.

structure.description: FR-027 structure enum — elevated (posts on grade) or floating (deck on grade).

floatingFraming.description: S26 (fix/floating-framing-joists) — OPTIONAL discriminator that selects the framing method for a floating deck. `beams-and-joists` (default) puts rim beams over blocks with joists on top at `joist.spacingMm`; `joists-on-blocks` places joists directly on blocks with no beam layer. IGNORED for elevated designs — the loader always sets the field to `beams-and-joists` (the default) if it is absent, so downstream consumers can treat it as required after `deserialize`. Optional so v2 files written before S26 remain load-compatible; when omitted the loader stamps the default (see `src/persistence/deck-file/schema-v2.ts`).

beamConnection.description: S27 (feat/joist-beam-connection) — OPTIONAL discriminator that selects the joist-to-beam connection geometry. `drop` (default; pre-S27 behavior) puts joists ON TOP of beams (joistBottomY === beamTopY). `flush` hangs joists on the SIDE of beams via joist hangers so joist TOP is level with beam TOP (joistTopY === beamTopY) — yields a shorter deck stack. Only meaningful when the design has BOTH beams AND joists: elevated (all foundation types) OR floating Method A (`floatingFraming` === `beams-and-joists`). IGNORED for floating Method B (`joists-on-blocks`; no beam layer). Optional so v2 files written before S27 remain load-compatible; when omitted the loader stamps the default `drop` (see `finalizeBeamConnection` in `src/persistence/deck-file/schema-v2.ts`).

FoundationSpec.description: FR-026 foundation discriminated union. Discriminator: `type`. Each variant carries only the fields its type requires; additionalProperties:false at each variant defends against prototype pollution and typo drift.

blockRowsHint.description: feat/block-count-per-joist — PRIMARY user control for Method B (floating 'joists-on-blocks') support density: the NUMBER of block ROWS along each joist (spread evenly end-to-end at layout time). Dimensionless positive integer. When set, blockRowsHint WINS over the legacy blockSpacingMm (which is superseded and now only consulted when this field is absent). Runtime clamp = min(rowsMaxByCap=floor(MAX_METHOD_B_BLOCK_COUNT/numJoists), rowsMaxByGap=floor(lengthMm/MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM)+1); both floored at 2 (perimeter-two invariant). minimum=2 mirrors that lower bound; maximum=100 is a generous fixed ceiling well above any physically-sensible grid. Omit for the span-safe absent-hint default (row count derived from the joist's IRC allowable when the pipeline threads a SpanTable through; falls back to a 1220 mm-derived count otherwise — byte-identical to pre-fix layouts).

blockColsHint.description: S25 (ticket #47) — OPTIONAL override for the derived block-column count under a floating deck. Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(widthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. See blockRowsHint for the bounds rationale. NO-OP under feat/joists-on-blocks-flying (block columns are pinned to joist x-centers — one column per joist).

blockSpacingMm.description: LEGACY (superseded by blockRowsHint in feat/block-count-per-joist). feat/block-spacing — OPTIONAL user-controlled distance between adjacent foundation blocks (grid PITCH, mm) for FLOATING 'joists-on-blocks' (Method B) framing; IGNORED for Method A ('beams-and-joists') and for elevated designs. Runtime layout clamps to [MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM (300), MAX_BLOCK_SPACING_MM (2438.4 ≈ 8 ft)] and further caps the total block count. minimum=300 mirrors the runtime density cap; maximum=2438.4 mirrors the practical DIY beam-column bound. When blockRowsHint is ALSO set, blockRowsHint wins and this field is ignored at layout time (kept in the schema for back-compat with designs saved under the pre-feat/block-count-per-joist model). Omit to apply the DEFAULT_METHOD_B_BLOCK_SPACING_MM (1220 mm ≈ 4 ft) at layout time.

blockRowsHint.description: feat/block-count-per-joist — PRIMARY user control for Method B (floating 'joists-on-blocks') support density: the NUMBER of block ROWS along each joist (spread evenly end-to-end at layout time). Dimensionless positive integer. When set, blockRowsHint WINS over the legacy blockSpacingMm (which is superseded and now only consulted when this field is absent). Runtime clamp = min(rowsMaxByCap=floor(MAX_METHOD_B_BLOCK_COUNT/numJoists), rowsMaxByGap=floor(lengthMm/MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM)+1); both floored at 2 (perimeter-two invariant). minimum=2 mirrors that lower bound; maximum=100 is a generous fixed ceiling well above any physically-sensible grid. Omit for the span-safe absent-hint default (row count derived from the joist's IRC allowable when the pipeline threads a SpanTable through; falls back to a 1220 mm-derived count otherwise — byte-identical to pre-fix layouts).

Dimensionless positive integer; the runtime layout clamps to [2, floor(widthMm / MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM) + 1]. See blockRowsHint for the bounds rationale. NO-OP under feat/joists-on-blocks-flying (block columns are pinned to joist x-centers — one column per joist).

blockSpacingMm.description: LEGACY (superseded by blockRowsHint in feat/block-count-per-joist). feat/block-spacing — OPTIONAL user-controlled distance between adjacent foundation blocks (grid PITCH, mm) for FLOATING 'joists-on-blocks' (Method B) framing; IGNORED for Method A ('beams-and-joists') and for elevated designs. Runtime layout clamps to [MIN_BLOCK_SPACING_MM (300), MAX_BLOCK_SPACING_MM (2438.4 ≈ 8 ft)] and further caps the total block count. FootingSpec.description: Poured-concrete footing dimensions for posts-on-footings foundations. Values are typical residential-deck sizes (300 mm ≈ 12" default).

FoundationBlockRef.description: SKU reference into the S17 foundation catalog. `productId` enum is pinned to the persistence-side FOUNDATION_PRODUCT_IDS constant (schema-constants.ts) which is compile-time equated to FoundationProductId (AC8).

Dimensions3D.description: 3D deck footprint. `widthMm`/`lengthMm` carry a TIGHTER upper bound than the generic `Mm` def (which permits 0..1000000) — feat/block-spacing HIGH #1 defense-in-depth: an unbounded deck size on the block-carrying variants combined with a tight `blockSpacingMm` could grow the derived block grid past MAX_METHOD_B_BLOCK_COUNT before the layout's cap could clamp it. Capping the footprint at MAX_DECK_DIMENSION_MM (30480 mm = 100 ft, 5× the largest existing golden and well within any residential deck) makes the closed-form block-grid cap unreachable-by-construction for any schema-legal input, and closes a pre-existing DoS on Method A + legacy elevated layouts that would otherwise instance millions of members for a 1 km × 1 km input. `heightMm` keeps the generic `Mm` bound.

Mm.description: Canonical millimeter length — finite non-negative number.
